An '''asteroid belt''' [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Ikon]] in the [[Ikon system/Legends|Ikon system]]. Although the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] monitored the [[Star system/Legends|system]] using [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sympathizers nevertheless set up operations in the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
